Strong negative baseline proving failure is replication not algorithm. Must be real requests with X-Worker-Pid>=10 per worker, 0 missing, shared-variable-free structural, de-confounded scheduling.

Shared-store fix: single SQLite WAL file at /tmp/spider-runtime-35860330078/shared.db (WAL, shared across both workers, check_same_thread=False, COMMIT verified via SELECT per batch >=27 lines distinct timestamps). Both workers connect to same file, HS256 shared-secret validates JWT via PyJWT decode to sessions row. Real HTTP via nginx round-robin, real If-None-Match/ETag->304, per-batch SELECT log. Status-free structural (hash(body) only), de-confounded body_variant random independent of drift, health-gated 0 missing. Expected TN>=0.85, n_non304>=800 stratified, r TOST within 0.15, 8/8 variance, FP<=0.15. Primary intervention for H1.

Sticky-session fix URL-bound without replication: per-node DB files (/tmp/spider-pernode-<worker>.db, NOT mirrored) but nginx sticky affinity via hash $request_uri consistent ensuring same URL hits same worker >90% skew. Same HS256 secret per worker, NO replicate_session_to_workers. Real HTTP with real URLs (3 endpoints providing URL entropy) via nginx. Expected TN>=0.85 as alternative to shared store if URL affinity suffices, distribution skewed >90% per worker for repeated URLs, reported separately. Tests H2 isolation vs shared-store replication.

Gradient reporting mandatory G1_BODY (32B 1B,33B 2B,35B 4B,70B 39B,117B 86B) and G2_HEADER (CC_small 3601 1s, CC_large 0, ETag_small 1char, ETag_large changed, SC_small, SC_large, Vary_small) each with full/body/headers/headers-no-CLEN Jaccard and CI [lo,hi] width degenerate effective_distinct_n via both direct and browser at N=20 — must be present even if all 1.0 degenerate (ordering unknown but not gating SUPPORTS). If any C1-C6 fails where validity passes (health gate 0 missing, status-free, de-confounded, real HTTP) => FALSIFIED-IN-SETTING bounded to failing branch (distributed vs browser). If shared-store C3 fails (|r|>=0.15) where validity passes => FALSIFIED-IN-SETTING for orthogonality (C-FRESHNESS orthogonality not restorable with this harness). If sticky URL-bound without replication also fails TN>=0.85 where validity passes => sticky FALSIFIED (affinity alone insufficient). If C1-C3 passes but gradients remain degenerate with N=20 => SUPPORTS still holds but ordering remains unknown (degenerate disclosure). If C2 power fails (<800) with C1/C3 passing => MEASUREMENT_INVALID (underpowered). If HS256 valid JWTs still all 401 => MEASUREMENT_INVALID HS256_VALIDATION_STILL_REJECTS_ALL. Any synthetic generation, inverted TN, hardcoded TOST, relabeled direct-as-browser, status prefix present, confounded scheduling, or health gate missing triggers MEASUREMENT_INVALID per frozen falsifier, not SUPPORTS/FALSIFIED. Infrastructure-unavailable branches map to MEASUREMENT_INVALID: gunicorn/nginx unavailable, shared store file creation fails, Playwright not installable, CDP not available, AgentLab 0.4.2 not on PyPI => respective branch MEASUREMENT_INVALID while other branch can still be decided (MIXED possible).
